draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and steady, stating a basic fact
notes: This is the most common verb in Greek, used for identity, characteristics, and location.
Unlike some other languages, Greek uses different verbs for temporary location (βρίσκομαι) and permanent identity (είμαι), though είμαι is frequently used for both in everyday speech.
